trophies.guide: The platinum, and the whole point of this ledger: it awards itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, with nothing extra to do. Plan around the long poles — 100% completion (A Long Road), the shooting-range golds and the stunt count — and let this one arrive last, exactly as the roadmap lays out.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI, as mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles (platinum entry and grade counts).
steps: Earn every other trophy in this list; the platinum has no task of its own.
Follow the roadmap order so the 100% grind and the one missable are handled before the finale.
When the 54th trophy pops, this one follows on the same screen.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, one of the early missions that teaches the fishing system on the Leonida coast. It cannot be missed: play the mission when it appears on the map, work through the catch tutorial, and the trophy lands with the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; mission placement per the GTA Wiki story mission index (gta.fandom.com).
steps: Pick up the Gone Fishing marker when it appears early in the story.
Follow the on-screen fishing tutorial and land the required catches.
Finish the drive back to complete the mission and earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 1 of the story. Pure progression: follow the chapter markers for Jason and Lucia, and the trophy pops at the chapter card. Nothing in this chapter is missable, and no collectible or side task is required.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; chapter structure per the GTA Wiki mission index.
steps: Play the story missions in order from the opening.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
The trophy awards as Chapter 2 begins.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 2, the chapter that opens up the drug-running side of Leonida's economy. Pure story progression again — the name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks and all, and the trophy pops at the end-of-chapter card.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase (name reproduced exactly as published); chapter structure per the GTA Wiki.
steps: Continue the story from Chapter 1's ending.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
The trophy awards as Chapter 3 begins.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 3, the chapter that puts Vice City itself at the centre of the story. Follow the markers through the city missions; the trophy lands when the chapter closes, and nothing along the way can be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; chapter structure per the GTA Wiki mission index.
steps: Continue the story from Chapter 2's ending.
Complete the chapter's final mission in Vice City.
The trophy awards as Chapter 4 begins.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 4. By this point the whole state is open, so the only way to delay this trophy is to wander off into free roam — which is fine, because it cannot be missed. Finish the chapter's final mission and it pops.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; chapter structure per the GTA Wiki mission index.
steps: Continue the story from Chapter 3's ending.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
The trophy awards as the endgame chapters begin.

trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the final story mission. Before you start it, clear the one missable trophy in the game (Actions Speak Louder, flagged on the Missables tab) and make a spare save — not because this trophy can be missed, but because the ending locks the story state. The trophy awards at the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; endgame structure per the GTA Wiki mission index.
steps: Finish every chapter and strand you want done before the point of no return.
Start the final mission and play it to the credits.
The trophy awards as the credits roll.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Breakfast Run mission, an early job that introduces partner driving with Jason and Lucia together. Follow the mission markers, keep the vehicle in one piece through the run, and the trophy pops on completion.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; mission identity per the GTA Wiki story mission index.
steps: Start Breakfast Run when its marker appears in the early story.
Run the route with your partner riding along, as the mission directs.
Reach the final marker to complete it and earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for The Cartel Heist, the first full heist of the campaign. Approach choices inside the mission do not affect the trophy — pick whichever crew and entry point you like, finish the job, and it awards on completion.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; mission identity per the GTA Wiki story mission index.
steps: Unlock and start The Cartel Heist from the story markers.
Complete the setup beats the mission asks for.
Finish the heist and escape to earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing Child's Play. It is a character mission rather than a score attack: play it when it appears, follow the objectives, and the trophy awards at the mission-complete screen regardless of how cleanly it went.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; mission identity per the GTA Wiki story mission index.
steps: Start Child's Play when its marker appears.
Follow the objectives to the end of the mission.
The trophy awards on completion.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing Headliners. Like the other named-mission trophies it is pure progression — no medal, timer or optional objective is attached — so the only requirement is to finish the mission when the story offers it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; mission identity per the GTA Wiki story mission index.
steps: Start Headliners when its marker appears.
Play the mission through to its final objective.
The trophy awards on completion.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing VCIA Takedown, the airport job at Vice City International. Expect a loud finish: bring armour and a full weapon wheel, finish the takedown, and the trophy pops with the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; VCIA as the game's airport per the GTA Wiki locations index.
steps: Start VCIA Takedown when its marker appears at the airport.
Fight through the takedown objectives as directed.
Escape the area to complete the mission and earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing Operation Savage Glory, one of the campaign's set-piece assaults. Stock up before the marker — the mission runs long — and the trophy awards when the operation wraps, however messy the middle got.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; mission identity per the GTA Wiki story mission index.
steps: Start Operation Savage Glory when its marker appears.
Complete the assault objectives in order.
The trophy awards on completion.

trophies.guide: The long pole of the platinum: reach 100% on the game's completion counter. The counter is a checklist, not a mystery — story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and property all feed it, and the in-game stats page shows which slice is short. Work the roadmap stages in order, sweep what remains with the tracker's filters, and expect this to be the last gold to land before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; completion-counter structure per the GTA Wiki 100% checklist for GTA VI.
steps: Finish the story and every character strand (the Stage 1 and 2 roadmap work).
Clear the collectible sets and activity types the completion counter tracks.
Open the stats page, find the missing slice, and finish it to reach 100%.
The trophy awards the moment the counter reads 100%.

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunt jumps and stunt events across Leonida. The stunt spots are fixed and marked once found; a fast bike and a habit of hitting every ramp you pass will quietly do most of this during the story, and the rest is a mop-up lap of the map with the tracker open. Failed attempts do not count — the landing has to stick.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles (tracked count: 250 stunts); stunt-spot approach per PowerPyx-style collectible guides.
steps: Take every marked ramp and jump you pass while travelling; clean landings count.
After the story, sweep the stunt list region by region on a fast bike.
The trophy awards on the 250th completed stunt.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game at least once — races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, drone events and the rest of the map icons. Nothing has to be won; starting each type once is enough, so this is a tour, not a test. Use the map's activity filter and tick them off in one free-roam session.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; activity-type list per the GTA Wiki activities index.
steps: Open the map and filter to activity icons.
Start one event of each distinct type (finishing is not required).
The trophy awards when the last untouched type is tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in every Shooting Range challenge — PlayStation tracks 42 of them. Learn each range's target pattern at bronze pace first, then chase gold with the weapon the challenge favours; accuracy bonuses matter more than raw speed on the later ranges. Medals are kept per challenge, so you can grind them one at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles (tracked count: 42 challenges, as the kit's trophy list notes); medal strategy per PowerPyx-style range guides.
steps: Unlock the shooting ranges and clear each challenge once to learn its pattern.
Replay challenges with their favoured weapon, prioritising accuracy bonuses.
The trophy awards when the last of the 42 challenges turns gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each race location around the state. The drones are twitchy but the AI field is beatable once you learn to cut corners inside the gates; learn each course with a practice run, then take the win. Locations tick off individually on the map.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; race-location approach per the GTA Wiki activities index.
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race start point on the map.
Learn the course with one run, then race it again to win.
The trophy awards when every location has a win.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — distinct events, not the same race twenty times. The online and contact race calendars rotate, so keep a list: this tracker's notes field is your memory. Favour short point-to-point races in a full lobby class you drive well, and bank the wins early while the fields are mixed.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; race-menu structure per the GTA Wiki online activities index.
steps: Enter races from the online/contact race menus and note which ones you have won.
Win on 20 distinct courses or events; repeats do not advance the count.
The trophy awards on the 20th distinct win.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal head-to-head in his fishing challenge. Cal is beatable once your tackle is upgraded a notch and you fish his spot at the time of day he calls: play his challenge from the map, keep tension on the line without snapping it, and land a heavier total than his. Losing costs nothing — challenge him again straight away.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; fishing system per the GTA Wiki activities index.
steps: Upgrade your rod and tackle once at a bait shop.
Accept Cal's fishing challenge from the map marker.
Out-catch his total weight before the timer ends to win and earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game in full. Leonida's arcades and bars carry cabinets; pick the shortest game on the cabinet, play it to its actual end screen rather than a high score, and the trophy pops. If a cabinet offers several games, the shortest is usually the puzzle one.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; arcade locations per the GTA Wiki activities index.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in a bar or arcade interior.
Play one game through to its completion screen.
The trophy awards as the game ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand: work his missions in order as they appear on the map until his final job, and complete it. Strand finals unlock only after the earlier jobs in the chain are done, so if the marker vanishes, clear the prerequisite job first. The trophy awards at the strand's end card.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; strand structure per the GTA Wiki Strangers and Freaks index.
steps: Take Andy's missions in order whenever his marker appears.
Start his final mission when the strand offers it.
Complete it to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand, the boat-heavy chain on the water side of Leonida. Work his jobs in order — several start at marinas, so keep a fast boat or seaplane handy — and complete his final mission when it unlocks. The trophy awards at the strand's end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; strand structure per the GTA Wiki Strangers and Freaks index.
steps: Take Kenton's missions in order whenever his marker appears.
Start his final mission when the strand offers it.
Complete it to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand, the lone-rider chain that mostly plays out on the highways at the state's edge. His jobs unlock in sequence and the last one only appears once the rest are done; complete it and the trophy awards at the end card.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; strand structure per the GTA Wiki Strangers and Freaks index.
steps: Take Billy's missions in order whenever his marker appears.
Start his final mission when the strand offers it.
Complete it to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. A strand only counts when its final mission is done, so finish chains rather than sampling first jobs: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five, and the map offers more. This tracker gives each of those strand finals its own entry, which makes counting easy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles (tracked count: 8 strands); strand list per the GTA Wiki Strangers and Freaks index.
steps: Pick up stranger strands from the question-mark markers across the state.
Finish each strand's final mission; only completed strands count.
The trophy awards when the eighth strand is complete.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand, built around buying, selling and the demand side of Leonida's grey economy. His jobs chain in order and pay for the next; complete the final mission when the strand offers it and the trophy awards at the end.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; strand structure per the GTA Wiki Strangers and Freaks index.
steps: Take Randy's missions in order whenever his marker appears.
Start his final mission when the strand offers it.
Complete it to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand, the racing-flavoured chain. Bring a tuned car to his later jobs — the strand assumes you can keep up — and complete his final mission when it unlocks. The trophy awards at the strand's end card.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; strand structure per the GTA Wiki Strangers and Freaks index.
steps: Take Tyrone's missions in order whenever his marker appears.
Start his final mission when the strand offers it.
Complete it to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate once at every meditation spot in the state — a collectible sweep in all but name. The spots sit at overlooks, beaches and hilltops; each is a short sit, and the map marks a spot once you have been near it. Plan a route by region, and use a helicopter for the hilltop ones to cut the sweep down to an evening.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; spot-hunting approach per PowerPyx-style collectible guides and the GTA Wiki collectibles index.
steps: Reveal meditation spots by exploring; each appears on the map once discovered.
Sit and complete the short meditation at every spot, region by region.
The trophy awards at the final spot.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track and hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. Bret's strand opens the hunting system; the unique animal only appears once his earlier hunts are done, in the habitat and hours his notes describe. Bring a scoped rifle, use the tracking prompts, and make the kill clean — the trophy awards when you report back to Bret.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; hunting system per the GTA Wiki activities index.
steps: Work Bret's hunting jobs until he names the unique animal.
Track it in the habitat and hours his notes describe.
Kill it and return to Bret to earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete any three full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered through interiors, rooftops and landmarks, and each set is themed; the in-game collection page shows what a set still needs. Focus one set at a time — partial progress across five themes earns nothing — and expect the last card of a set to be the one on a roof.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; card-set structure per the GTA Wiki collectibles index.
steps: Pick one card set and collect every card in it from the collection page's hints.
Repeat for a second and third set.
The trophy awards when the third set is complete.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK spot at 100 different locations — the street-art and photo spots scattered over the state each count once. They are quick stops, best swept in the same regional laps as the meditation spots and card sets, and the map greys out locations already done. A helicopter turns the whole list into one long evening.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles (tracked count: 100 locations); spot approach per PowerPyx-style collectible guides.
steps: Find WAiNK spots as you explore; each new one appears on the map.
Use each spot once — 100 distinct locations are required.
The trophy awards at the 100th location.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's rotating Challenges — the short scored tasks the world and your phone offer (deliveries, escapes, trick lines, clean laps). They are everywhere and mostly quick; the efficient play is to accept every challenge you pass and abandon the awkward ones, because only completions count and there are far more than 50 on offer.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase (tracked count: 50 challenges); challenge system per the GTA Wiki activities index.
steps: Accept challenges from the phone and world markers as you travel.
Finish the quick ones; abandon any that stall — only completions count.
The trophy awards on the 50th completed challenge.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner riding with you, then lose it completely. The reliable method: cause mayhem together until four stars, then break line of sight and hide in the countryside or a parking structure until the stars drain — swapping vehicles mid-escape speeds it up. Both characters must be together when the heat dies.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; wanted-system behaviour per the GTA Wiki wanted level index.
steps: Pick up your partner so you are travelling together.
Raise the wanted level to 4 stars with crimes committed together.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until all stars are gone.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive the whole time — if the stars fully drain between shops, the chain resets. Plan a triangle of stores on one street, drive hard between them, and rob the third before the heat from the first expires. Your partner must be with you for all three tills.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; shop-robbery mechanics per the GTA Wiki activities index.
steps: Collect your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first till and drive straight to the second, keeping the wanted level active.
Rob the third shop before the heat dies to earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — a vehicle counts when you get in and drive it, and the vehicle log in the stats keeps the tally. Traffic variety rises in richer districts and at the airport; steal broadly, check the log for gaps by class, and buy or order anything the streets refuse to spawn. This finishes naturally during a long playthrough if you never settle into one car.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles (tracked count: 100 vehicles); vehicle-log structure per the GTA Wiki vehicles index.
steps: Get into and drive every distinct model you see; the log records each discovery.
Hunt missing classes in rich districts, marinas and the airport.
The trophy awards at the 100th distinct vehicle.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus, the slow-motion combat state. Set it up rather than hoping for it: start a gang hideout or a late story shootout where enemies cluster, top up the Focus meter first, trigger it at a doorway, and sweep targets head-first. If the fifth falls after the meter ends, it does not count — density is everything.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; Combat Focus mechanics per the GTA Wiki abilities index.
steps: Fill the Combat Focus meter in ordinary fights.
Find a clustered group of five or more enemies, such as a hideout doorway.
Activate Focus once and take down five before the meter empties.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an aircraft at Vice City International Airport and take off without clearance — an 'unscheduled departure'. The airfield is restricted, so expect stars the moment you cross the fence: grab the nearest plane on the apron, taxi straight onto the runway, and get wheels-up before the response pins you. The trophy awards once you are airborne.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; VCIA layout per the GTA Wiki locations index.
steps: Enter the VCIA airfield through a fence gap or gate.
Board the nearest usable aircraft on the apron.
Take off from the runway to earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: The description is the hint: Rhinos are the army's tanks, and it gets hot inside them because everyone shoots at you. Steal a Rhino — from a military response at high wanted levels or a base perimeter — and survive in it: run a rampage until the trophy pops, using the cannon on anything that corners you. The tank's armour makes the surviving part easy; getting in is the hard part.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase (description reproduced as published); Rhino as the military tank per the GTA Wiki vehicles index.
steps: Draw a military response at a high wanted level, or approach a base perimeter.
Steal a Rhino and get clear of the spawn area.
Rampage in the tank until the trophy awards.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Empty a jewelry store's cases without ever being detected — no alarm raised, no witness call completing. Case the store first: enter near closing, use a suppressed approach on the guard, keep customers faced away, and smash only once the room is controlled. If a detection icon fills, restart the attempt; a clean run is short once the route is rehearsed.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; stealth and witness mechanics per the GTA Wiki activities index.
steps: Scout a jewelry store and note the guard and camera positions.
Enter quietly, control the room without raising detection.
Loot the cases and leave undetected to earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Vault jobs sit a step above shop robberies: they need the entry tool the story and contacts provide, a driver, and an escape route that avoids the first roadblock ring. Banks reset after some in-game days, so rotate across the state's branches rather than waiting on one.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; bank-robbery structure per the GTA Wiki activities index.
steps: Unlock vault robbery gear through the story and your contacts.
Crack a bank vault, take the money and escape the wanted level.
Repeat at four more banks to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armoured truck and get away. The trucks run fixed cash routes; the reliable ambush is a quiet stretch of highway — block it with a heavy vehicle, breach the rear doors with explosives or the story's cutting gear, grab the cash, and lose the escort's wanted level in the hills. One clean truck is all the trophy asks.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; armoured-truck routes per the GTA Wiki activities index.
steps: Find an armoured truck on its cash route.
Ambush it on a quiet road and breach the rear doors.
Take the cash and escape the wanted level to earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: Visit every region of the state so the whole map is uncovered. Exploration registers by district, not by road: a helicopter or seaplane pass over each region's interior is the fast way, with a drive through any district that stays fogged afterwards. Leave this until the story has opened everything, then do one full circuit of the state.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; region layout per the GTA Wiki locations index for Leonida.
steps: Wait until the story has opened the whole state.
Fly or drive a full circuit, crossing every district's interior.
Check the map for fogged patches and visit whatever remains.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation run by each of Leonida's gangs — every gang's business type once: the chop shops, labs, fronts and stash houses differ, but each has a take to steal. Gang operations show on the map once discovered or after the story introduces them; hit one per gang, escape, and the set is done. Keep a list — repeats for the same gang do not advance it.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; gang-operation types per the GTA Wiki activities index.
steps: Discover each gang's illegal operations through the story and the map.
Rob one operation belonging to the first gang and escape.
Repeat once for every other gang to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The quiet one: order a cocktail at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and drink it looking at the water. Walk the Ocean Beach strip, find a bar or hotel terrace that serves drinks, order from the prompt, and let the animation finish — the trophy awards as the moment lands. Best done at sunset, obviously.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; Ocean Beach as a Vice City district per the GTA Wiki locations index.
steps: Head to the Ocean Beach strip in Vice City.
Find a beachfront bar or terrace serving drinks.
Order a cocktail and let the drinking animation finish.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car out through a vehicle showroom's glass front — in classic style means stealing the display car itself. Pick a showroom with a car on the floor, get in, and accelerate straight through the window rather than the door. One dramatic exit is all it takes; the wanted level afterwards is your own problem.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; showroom interiors per the GTA Wiki locations index.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a display car inside.
Get into the display car.
Accelerate out through the glass front to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, score a follow-through — the alley's signature shot, a strike finished with the celebration the lane prompts for. Play a game at that specific alley (other alleys do not count), line up a strike, and hit the follow-through prompt as it appears. A few frames of practice make the timing plain.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; bowling activity per the GTA Wiki activities index.
steps: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game and bowl a strike.
Hit the follow-through prompt to earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: The co-op trophy: complete a partner activity with another player and have the partnership rated by the crowd — the in-game partner events score style as well as success. Queue a partner event from the online menu, finish it cleanly with a random or a friend, and let the rating land; a smooth run with a few stylish moments clears the bar.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; partner-event structure per the GTA Wiki online activities index.
steps: Queue a partner event from the online menu.
Complete it with another player, driving or playing cleanly.
The trophy awards when the partnership rating is posted.

trophies.guide: THE missable trophy of the game — the only one. It turns on a story choice late in the campaign: when the game puts a real decision in front of Jason and Lucia, the trophy is earned by seeing the choice through one specific way, and a save that has passed it cannot go back. Keep a separate manual save at the start of the final chapters, read the on-screen framing carefully when the choice comes, and if you take the other branch, reload the spare save after the credits and choose again. Every other trophy in the game survives the ending; this one does not.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase (description reproduced as published); missable analysis per the GTA Wiki story mission index and PSNProfiles' missable flags.
steps: Make a separate manual save at the start of the final chapters.
When the late-story choice arrives, read the framing and pick deliberately.
If the trophy does not pop, reload the spare save after the credits and choose the other way.

trophies.guide: A hidden story beat whose description is the guide: something in the campaign fails the first time by design and succeeds on the second attempt. Play the story naturally — a late mission sequence is built around a retry — and the trophy awards when the second attempt lands. It cannot be missed while following the story.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; story-beat identity per the GTA Wiki mission index.
steps: Continue the story into the late chapters.
Play the scripted fail-and-retry sequence as it comes.
The trophy awards when the second attempt succeeds.

trophies.guide: A hidden story trophy for one of the campaign's strangest scripted moments — the description is the only honest summary of it. It is unmissable and needs no setup: when the story takes its weirdest turn, this pops. If you finish the game without it, you somehow skipped a main mission — you did not; it is part of the road.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; story-beat identity per the GTA Wiki mission index.
steps: Play the story in order.
Reach the late-campaign scripted set-piece this describes.
The trophy awards as the scene resolves.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down pedestrians with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by swing, not a collision. Ride a motorcycle or hang out of a car with a melee weapon, line up a group on a pavement, and swing as you pass: the knockdowns have to come from the weapon, so keep speed moderate and let the bat, not the bumper, do the work.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles; drive-by melee mechanics per the GTA Wiki combat index.
steps: Equip a melee weapon and take a motorcycle or open car.
Find a group of pedestrians on a pavement.
Swing the weapon as you pass so the knockdowns come from the hit, not the vehicle.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a quarter of a million dollars of Marked Bills through your fence contacts. Marked bills come from the robberies that pay dirty — vaults, trucks and operations — and each contact launders a capped amount per visit at a cut. Bank the dirty cash instead of spending it, rotate contacts as their caps reset, and the total climbs fastest if every big score goes through the wash before you touch it.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase (tracked amount: $250,000); money-laundering contacts per the GTA Wiki economy index.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from vault, truck and operation robberies.
Visit laundering contacts and wash the maximum each allows.
Rotate contacts as caps reset until $250,000 has been laundered.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, vehicles, properties' counters, food and services all count toward the one tally. It accrues on its own through a platinum run (garages and tuning alone pass it), so the only mistake is hoarding: buy the good guns and the nice jacket when you see them.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles (tracked amount: $100,000); shop types per the GTA Wiki economy index.
steps: Spend normally across clothes, weapon and vehicle shops as you play.
Top up with tuning and property purchases if the tally lags.
The trophy awards when total shop spending reaches $100,000.

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the map. Garages unlock for purchase as their districts open, and the set is the expensive part of the property ladder — fund it with the robbery circuit (vaults, trucks, operations) rather than missions. The property list in the phone shows what is left; buy the last one and the trophy awards at the deed screen.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase; property list per the GTA Wiki properties index.
steps: Open the property list and note every garage for sale.
Fund the purchases with the robbery circuit.
Buy the final garage to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game vehicle registry on your phone. Any owned vehicle can be registered from the app once you are in it; stolen cars must be made yours first (garage or insurer, as the app directs). Register as you acquire and this is done long before the collection trophies are.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official trophy list via PSNProfiles (tracked count: 10 vehicles); Scooter Bros app per the GTA Wiki phone apps index.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone.
Make a vehicle yours (garage or insurer), then register it in the app.
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered.
